annotations.title: Vehicle history check: stolen, written off or on finance

description: What the paid MotifyMe vehicle history check covers and the link to run it: stolen markers, insurance write-offs (Cat S, Cat N and older categories), outstanding finance, scrapped or salvaged, imported or exported, plate and colour changes, and number of previous keepers, for buyers and sellers of UK cars. This tool does not look up those records and its result is not confirmation that a vehicle is clear. The link has the registration filled in when one is given.
